description: This file defines the FormatterFactory class, responsible for creating and managing formatter instances for data sources in the SuiteCRM system. It contains logic for selecting, loading, and caching formatter objects based on source and formatter names, including handling custom overrides and template files.

classes.name: FormatterFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating, caching, and retrieving formatter instances based on source and formatter names. It manages the inclusion of formatter files, handles custom and default formats, and sets template files for formatters.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a formatter instance for a given source name and optional formatter name, loading the appropriate formatter class and setting its component and template file.
